newsitem.title: USA: M.A. Hanna may meet estimates, raise div - Barron's.
newsitem.headline: M.A. Hanna may meet estimates, raise div - Barron's.

text.p: M.A. Hanna Co has moved away from the wild earnings swings of the past and remains on track to meet the $1.27 a share consensus earnings estimate for continuing operations for 1996, a Barron's report said.
The consensus estimate for 1997 is $1.46 a share, Barron's said.

Douglas McGregor, M.A. Hanna's president, told Barron's that if profits from continuing operations maintain an upward trend, the specialty chemical company's board would likely raise the quarterly dividend from its $0.10 level.
